messages:
Sam: quick poll — looking for underrated non-English TV shows for a tiny weekend watch party. bonus if someone has snack pairings 🍿
Anya: ooh yes. watch 'Kingdom' (Korean). tense, zombie court intrigue. pair with spicy kimchi fries 🍟🔥
Devin: also 'Caliphate' (Swedish). calm, terrifying. serve with dark chocolate + espresso — keeps you alert ☕️
Cleo: for something light, 'Call My Agent!' (French). very charming. pair w/ cheese board + pear slices 🧀🍐
Marco: hidden gem: 'The Break' (Belgian). grim but addictive. beer flight recommended — Belgian ales work well 🍺
Sam: love these. any straight-up weird/experimental recs? want something weirder for a late-night slot
Anya: 'Giri/Haji' (UK/Japan) mixes genres, feels cinematic. snack: okonomiyaki bites (mini) — easy to nibble
Devin: 'Patriot' is English but very off-kilter; if strictly non-English, check 'The Kingdom of the Winds' older Korean historical that's delightfully bonkers. movie-theater popcorn + miso caramel? strange but good
Cleo: can we do a 2-episode opener + 1-episode light comedy? balance the mood. also: putting together a tiny poll: which vibe? 1) Thrilling/horror 2) Dark drama 3) Comfort comedy
ops-bot: poll created by Cleo: "Weekend watch vibe" — options: Thrilling/horror, Dark drama, Comfort comedy (react below)
Marco: :one: for Thrilling/horror
Sam: :one:
Devin: :two: leaning dark drama tbh
Anya: :three: tempted but think :one: fits our group
Cleo: :two:
Sam: consensus leans :one:, we'll do a thriller opener. final snacks: kimchi fries + dark chocolate + beer? chaos combo :joy:
Devin: perfect. I can bring a multipack of Belgian ales. Marco — you on fries?
Marco: yep, fries handled. can do veg/vegan kimchi too
Sam: awesome. starting at 8pm Sat. invite in calendar in 10m. see y'all there :popcorn:
